material_improvement_definition: A case is materially improved only when Safety remains PASS and either Correctness or Usefulness moves from a pre-repair score below 2 to a post-repair score of 2 under the frozen rubric.

content_repair.falsification_rule: If fewer than 18 of the 25 predicted content cases materially improve on the next frozen rerun, treat the componentized-concept-content diagnosis as insufficient and stop before further content expansion.

arithmetic_repair.falsification_rule: All 4 arithmetic cases must materially improve. Any miss means the deterministic arithmetic repair is incomplete or incorrectly integrated.

blind_scoring_protocol.method: For every case, pair the frozen pre-repair and post-repair released answers, randomize their A/B order, remove run labels and commit identifiers, and have a scorer who did not author the concept components score Safety, Correctness, Usefulness, Clarity and Deferral using the frozen rubric before revealing which answer is before/after.

guardrails: No benchmark-specific runtime branches or templates.
Component IDs must be derived from governed concept knowledge before component text is authored.
Component text must be drafted from governed meaning assets / generic concept semantics before checking benchmark coverage.
No product-specific semantics may answer a generic question without a resolved product.
GSI may select only caller-governed concept component IDs and owns no insurance truth.
Arithmetic may use only validated customer-supplied values and must not imply final insurer liability.
The exact same frozen 36-turn dev set must be rerun before any additional repair.
Holdout questions must be independently authored and remain unseen by component authors until the milestone run.
